notes:
Dahu 0.98.2 beta for Windows

- More reliable opening and importing of complex 3DM models: display data is split into smaller, losslessly compressed transfers instead of one very large response.
- Long operations can recover from interrupted connections without repeating the command. Display loading shows progress.
- Removed the remaining 24 MiB autosave and recovery limit.
- Reduced temporary memory allocations when preparing viewport geometry.

Validated with 150 automated checks, long-operation interruption recovery, and Windows desktop/updater signature checks. Conversion of very complex models can still take several minutes; existing mesh fallbacks for some Rhino objects are unchanged.
